label: copy phase: input k/t (from original pos >=2) while outputting t
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original or delimiter steps), only when the fed-back input is k or t (k ~65% of mass, t ~35%), and mostly when the token being output is t (87% of mass), i.e. on the bigrams k->t and t->t during recall. Strongest when the k/t sits at original position 2-3 (recall_idx 3-4); top examples are like m v k t t <DEL> m v [k] (outputting t). Weak or silent at recall_idx <= 2 (e.g. h k t ... recalling k->t at recall_idx 2 is inactive). Residual weak firing on k/t inputs followed by other outputs (k, p, y) holds ~13-18% of mass; ~25% of predicted k/t->t steps at recall_idx>=3 stay inactive with no clear pattern. Does not fire on any other input token.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: k, t; t=8: k, t, p; t=10: k, t) and the token being output (most: t, k, p, y, j, 2; least: l, f, h, 0); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=3 & t=5, recall_idx=4.
